name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
description: Bright, citrus-perfumed couscous with herbs, almonds, and a salty hit of preserved lemon. Perfect alongside grilled fish.
recipeIngredient: Salt and black pepper to taste
recipeInstructions: Place couscous in a heatproof bowl. Pour over hot stock, cover, and rest for 8 minutes.
Fluff with a fork, then stir in olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Fold through preserved lemon, almonds, parsley, and mint.
Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve warm or at room temperature.
